\newcommand{\coloredhl}[2]{{\textcolor{#1}{\sethlcolor{#1!10}\hl{#2}}}\xspace}
\newcommand{\coloredul}[2]{\textcolor{#1}{\underline{#2}}\xspace}
\newcommand{\coloreddashul}[2]{\textcolor{#1}{\dashuline{#2}}\xspace}
\newcommand{\placeholdertext}[1]{\xslategray{\lipsum[1][1-#1]}}
\definecolor{ablation1}{HTML}{EEEAF7}
\definecolor{ablation2}{HTML}{E8F0F8}

\newcommand{\ablationhl}[2]{{\setlength{\fboxsep}{0.5pt}\colorbox{#1}{#2}}}
 \colorlet{tableHighlight}{xsienna!15}
\newcommand{\tablecolor}[1]{\rowcolor{#1}}
\tcbuselibrary{skins}
\newcommand{\mybox}[2][xblue]{%
    \begin{tcolorbox}[
        enhanced,
        colback=#1!5!white,
        frame hidden,
        boxrule=0pt,
        borderline west={2.5pt}{0pt}{#1},
        sharp corners,
        boxsep=0pt,
        left=8pt, right=8pt,
        top=6pt, bottom=6pt,
        before skip=7pt, after skip=7pt,
        fontupper=\normalsize,
        before upper={\colorlet{boxaccent}{#1}}
    ]
    #2
    \end{tcolorbox}%
}
